evidence.primary: Targeted direct inspection of the bottom-right area of the 1737 facsimile clearly distinguishes the guide `Azofar` from the following separate article `Azotar con cuero, ò ſoga. Abeba.`
evidence.secondaryControl: BUE1890 preserves the same lexical distinction and is treated only as later corroborating evidence, not as authority over ALC1737.

impact: p135 missed-start record for Azofar can now link to article 000704
a distinct historical article must still be promoted for `Azotar con cuero, ò ſoga. Abeba.`
